Lemma
[Transition maps: composition]

↗ def:ends-transition

For compact $K\subset K'\subset K''$, the transition from $K''$ to $K$ is the composite through $K'$. Thus $K\mapsto \pi _0(X\setminus K)$ is an inverse system.
Proof

\sketch

This follows from transitivity and uniqueness of the containing component.

□
